notes: La tablet sube tres cambios: el expediente con el teléfono nuevo (y FieldStampsJson con la marca del campo, paso 8.22), una cita nueva y el borrado de la nota (su lápida). Con algo que subir, la primera petición es la de la hora del servidor y las claves de _tpvc_meta (8.7: mide el desfase y revisa clinicId, generation y el protocolo antes de escribir).

La subida va en una petición batch con BEGIN/COMMIT (atómica, V14): por tabla en el orden de schema.json, cada fila con el upsert de la nube (INSERT … SELECT … WHERE NOT EXISTS lápida igual o más nueva AND la cerca de generación ON CONFLICT(SyncId) DO UPDATE … WHERE excluded.UpdatedAtUtc > UpdatedAtUtc, golden/lww.json), cada lápida con su upsert y el DELETE de la fila, y al final el SELECT de la generación (si cambió, nada de esto vale: generation-fence.jsonl). affected_row_count = 0 en un upsert es una fila que la nube no aceptó (tie-conflict.jsonl, tombstone-vs-edit.jsonl).
Después de subir, el latido con LastPushUtc (regla «Latido»: la marca de cambios que leen los demás, paso 8.24) y la bajada incremental en una sola petición, como en incremental.jsonl.

La sonda del esquema, la escritura del manifiesto y el registro en DeviceRegistry, si aparecen, son de la PC: Kotlin no corre DDL ni se registra solo. Las instrucciones de escritura no van en statements.json: Kotlin puede escribirlas con otro texto si hacen lo mismo (las reglas de lww.json), salvo folio.take y folio.raise y, desde la revisión 19, las del perfil y el membrete (profile.write y asset.*).

Marcadores: <time> = una hora que cambia en cada corrida, <id:N> = un GUID al azar, <nonce:N> = el InstanceNonce, <appVersion> = la versión de TPVC, <osDescription> = el sistema de la computadora que grabó. Los SyncId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-… son fijos.

stmt.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AS now, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now','-5 seconds') AS wm, (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'clinicId') AS "clinicId", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') AS "generation", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generationReady') AS "generationReady", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generationPrevious') AS "generationPrevious", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'protocol') AS "protocol", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'minClientProtocol') AS "minClientProtocol", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'fullUploadAtUtc') AS "fullUploadAtUtc", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'stampsRepairedAtUtc') AS "stampsRepairedAtUtc";
BEGIN

INSERT INTO "Patients" ("SyncId", "UpdatedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId", "AbortionsCount", "ActivePrescriptionJson", "ActiveServicesJson", "ActiveSuppliesJson", "Address", "Age", "Allergies", "BirthDate", "BloodType", "CesareansCount", "ChronicDiseases", "ClinicalNotes", "CreatedAt", "DevelopmentalMilestones", "Diet", "Email", "EmergencyContactName", "EmergencyContactPhone", "FamilyHistory", "FieldStampsJson", "FullName", "Gender", "GestationalWeeks", "Hospitalizations", "HousingConditions", "ImmunizationSchedule", "IsActive", "IsCurrentlyPregnant", "IsPeriodHeavy", "LastDiagnosis", "LastVisit", "MenarcheAge", "MergedIntoSyncId", "NextAppointmentDate", "NextAppointmentNotes", "NextAppointmentReason", "NextAppointmentTime", "Occupation", "OriginalFolio", "PapSmear", "PeriodDuration", "Phone", "PregnanciesCount", "RecordNumber", "Religion", "SexualOnsetAge", "SexualPartnersCount", "Surgeries", "Transfusions", "VitalSigns", "Zoonosis") SELECT ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SyncTombstones" WHERE "EntityType" = ? AND "SyncId" = ? AND "DeletedAtUtc" >= ?) AND (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') IS ? ON CONFLICT("SyncId") DO UPDATE SET "UpdatedAtUtc" = excluded."UpdatedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc" = excluded."SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId" = excluded."OriginDeviceId", "AbortionsCount" = excluded."AbortionsCount", "ActivePrescriptionJson" = excluded."ActivePrescriptionJson", "ActiveServicesJson" = excluded."ActiveServicesJson", "ActiveSuppliesJson" = excluded."ActiveSuppliesJson", "Address" = excluded."Address", "Age" = excluded."Age", "Allergies" = excluded."Allergies", "BirthDate" = excluded."BirthDate", "BloodType" = excluded."BloodType", "CesareansCount" = excluded."CesareansCount", "ChronicDiseases" = excluded."ChronicDiseases", "ClinicalNotes" = excluded."ClinicalNotes", "CreatedAt" = excluded."CreatedAt", "DevelopmentalMilestones" = excluded."DevelopmentalMilestones", "Diet" = excluded."Diet", "Email" = excluded."Email", "EmergencyContactName" = excluded."EmergencyContactName", "EmergencyContactPhone" = excluded."EmergencyContactPhone", "FamilyHistory" = excluded."FamilyHistory", "FieldStampsJson" = excluded."FieldStampsJson", "FullName" = excluded."FullName", "Gender" = excluded."Gender", excluded."NextAppointmentTime", "Occupation" = excluded."Occupation", "OriginalFolio" = excluded."OriginalFolio", "PapSmear" = excluded."PapSmear", "PeriodDuration" = excluded."PeriodDuration", "Phone" = excluded."Phone", "PregnanciesCount" = excluded."PregnanciesCount", "RecordNumber" = excluded."RecordNumber", "Religion" = excluded."Religion", "SexualOnsetAge" = excluded."SexualOnsetAge", "SexualPartnersCount" = excluded."SexualPartnersCount", "Surgeries" = excluded."Surgeries", "Transfusions" = excluded."Transfusions", "VitalSigns" = excluded."VitalSigns", "Zoonosis" = excluded."Zoonosis" WHERE excluded."UpdatedAtUtc" > "Patients"."UpdatedAtUtc";

INSERT INTO "Appointments" ("SyncId", "UpdatedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId", "CreatedAt", "Date", "DurationMinutes", "Notes", "PatientName", "PatientPhone", "PatientRecordNumber", "Reason", "Status", "Time", "PatientRecordSyncId") SELECT ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SyncTombstones" WHERE "EntityType" = ? AND "SyncId" = ? AND "DeletedAtUtc" >= ?) AND (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') IS ? ON CONFLICT("SyncId") DO UPDATE SET "UpdatedAtUtc" = excluded."UpdatedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc" = excluded."SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId" = excluded."OriginDeviceId", "CreatedAt" = excluded."CreatedAt", "Date" = excluded."Date", "DurationMinutes" = excluded."DurationMinutes", "Notes" = excluded."Notes", "PatientName" = excluded."PatientName", "PatientPhone" = excluded."PatientPhone", "PatientRecordNumber" = excluded."PatientRecordNumber", "Reason" = excluded."Reason", "Status" = excluded."Status", "Time" = excluded."Time", "PatientRecordSyncId" = excluded."PatientRecordSyncId" WHERE excluded."UpdatedAtUtc" > "Appointments"."UpdatedAtUtc";

INSERT INTO "SyncTombstones" ("EntityType", "SyncId", "DeletedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId") SELECT ?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), ? WHERE (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') IS ? ON CONFLICT("EntityType", "SyncId") DO UPDATE SET "DeletedAtUtc" = excluded."DeletedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc" = excluded."SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId" = excluded."OriginDeviceId" WHERE excluded."DeletedAtUtc" > "SyncTombstones"."DeletedAtUtc";
DELETE FROM "PatientConsultations" WHERE "SyncId" = ? AND "UpdatedAtUtc" <= ? AND (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') IS ?;
SELECT "Value" AS "generation" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation';
COMMIT
ROLLBACK
SELECT InstanceNonce FROM RegisteredDevices WHERE DeviceId = ?;

INSERT INTO RegisteredDevices (DeviceId, DeviceName, DeviceRole, AppVersion, Platform, SyncProtocol, HandoffProtocol, ContractRevision, PendingCount, OldestPendingUtc, InstanceNonce, LastSeenUtc, LastPushUtc) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')) ON CONFLICT(DeviceId) DO UPDATE SET DeviceName = excluded.DeviceName, DeviceRole = excluded.DeviceRole, AppVersion = excluded.AppVersion, Platform = excluded.Platform, SyncProtocol = excluded.SyncProtocol, HandoffProtocol = excluded.HandoffProtocol, ContractRevision = excluded.ContractRevision, PendingCount = excluded.PendingCount, OldestPendingUtc = excluded.OldestPendingUtc, InstanceNonce = excluded.InstanceNonce, LastSeenUtc = excluded.LastSeenUtc, LastPushUtc = excluded.LastPushUtc;
